description: The image displays two side-by-side hierarchical pie charts, or sunburst charts, titled "AttentionInfluence" (left) and "FineWeb-Edu Classifier" (right), representing a categorized breakdown of data. Each chart features an inner ring of primary categories and an outer ring of subcategories, with numerical values indicating percentages. The left chart's inner ring contains six slices: Education 25 (green), History & Society 23 (orange), Health & Medicine 22 (blue), Science 15 (red), Tech & Engineer 12 (brown), and Fin & Law 3 (light blue). Its outer ring contains fifteen slices: Teaching & resources 15 and Science & technology education 10 (green); Diseases 11, Medical 6, and Nutrition 5 (blue); Animal & Plant 13 and Materials 2 (red); Historical review 7, Society & culture 10, and Events & people 6 (orange); Infor tech 5, Materials 3, Emerging tech 4, and Manage 2 (brown); and Policy 1 (light blue). The right chart's inner ring contains six slices: Education 38 (green), Health & Medicine 19 (blue), History & Society 19 (orange), Science 15 (red), Tech & Engineer 8 (brown), and a tiny light blue slice labeled "...". Its outer ring contains fifteen labeled slices: Teaching & resources 17, Healthy education 2, and Science & technology education 19 (green); Diseases 10, Nutrition 7, and Medical 2 (blue); Animal & Plant 12 and Materials 3 (red); Historical review 12, Society & culture 5, and one blurred label with the number 2 (orange); and Infor tech 3, Materials 1, Emerging tech 4, and Manage 1 (brown). Neither chart includes a separate legend; labels and values are placed inside larger slices or outside with leader lines pointing to smaller slices. In both charts, the green "Education" segment is visually emphasized by being exploded, or offset, from the rest of the chart. The segments are grouped by their primary color categories rather than being ordered by descending size.
